lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ghar hee so pir paaiaa sachai sabad veechaar ||1||
lines.translation: They find their Husband Lord within their own home, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣੀ ਬਖਸਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: avagan gunee bakhasaaiaa har siu liv laaee ||
lines.translation: Through merits, their demerits are forgiven, and they embrace love for the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har var paaiaa kaamanee gur mel milaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride then obtains the Lord as her Husband; meeting the Guru, this union comes about. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik pir hadoor na jaananhee doojai bharam bhulaai ||
lines.translation: Some do not know the Presence of their Husband Lord; they are deluded by duality and doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਪਾਇਨੑਿ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kiu paainhi dohaaganee dukhee rain vihaai ||2||
lines.translation: How can the forsaken brides meet Him? Their life night passes in pain. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kai man sach vasiaa sachee kaar kamaai ||
lines.translation: Those whose minds are filled with the True Lord, perform truthful actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਿਉ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: anadin sevahi sahaj siu sache maahi samaai ||3||
lines.translation: Night and day, they serve the Lord with poise, and are absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਈਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dohaaganee bharam bhulaaeeaa kooR bol bikh khaahi ||
lines.translation: The forsaken brides wander around, deluded by doubt; telling lies, they eat poison.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਸੇਜ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: pir na jaanan aapanaa su(n)njee sej dukh paahi ||4||
lines.translation: They do not know their Husband Lord, and upon their deserted bed, they suffer in misery. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਮਤੁ ਮਨ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saahib ek hai mat man bharam bhulaahi ||
lines.translation: The True Lord is the One and only; do not be deluded by doubt, O my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur poochh sevaa karahi sach niramal ma(n)n vasaahi ||5||
lines.translation: Consult with the Guru, serve the True Lord, and enshrine the Immaculate Truth within your mind. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sohaaganee sadaa pir paaiaa haumai aap gavaai ||
lines.translation: The happy soul-bride always finds her Husband Lord; she banishes egotism and self-conceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੀ ਸਚੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: pir setee anadin gahi rahee sachee sej sukh paai ||6||
lines.translation: She remains attached to her Husband Lord, night and day, and she finds peace upon His Bed of Truth. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਪਲੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: meree meree kar gae palai kichh na paai ||
lines.translation: Those who shouted, "Mine, mine!" have departed, without obtaining anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: mahal naahee dohaaganee a(n)t gaee pachhutaai ||7||
lines.translation: The separated one does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and departs, repenting in the end. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so pir meraa ek hai ekas siu liv laai ||
lines.translation: That Husband Lord of mine is the One and only; I am in love with the One alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੧॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak je sukh loRahi kaamanee har kaa naam ma(n)n vasaai ||8||11||33||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if the soul-bride longs for peace, she should enshrine the Lord's Name within her mind. ||8||11||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਚਖਾਇਓਨੁ ਰਸੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit jinhaa chakhaaion ras aaiaa sahaj subhaai ||
lines.translation: Those whom the Lord has caused to drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, naturally, intuitively, enjoy the sublime essence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa veparavaahu hai tis no til na tamaai ||1||
lines.translation: The True Lord is care-free; he does not have even an iota of greed. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit sachaa varasadaa guramukhaa mukh paai ||
lines.translation: The True Ambrosial Nectar rains down, and trickles into the mouths of the Gurmukhs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man sadaa hareeaavalaa sahaje har gun gaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Their minds are forever rejuvenated, and they naturally, intuitively, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਦਰਿ ਖੜੀਆ ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh sadaa dohaaganee dar khaReeaa bilalaahi ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are forever forsaken brides; they cry out and bewail at the Lord's Gate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jinhaa pir kaa suaad na aaio jo dhur likhiaa sou kamaahi ||2||
lines.translation: Those who do not enjoy the sublime taste of their Husband Lord, act according to their pre-ordained destiny. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੀਜੇ ਸਚੁ ਜਮੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh beeje sach jamai sach naam vaapaar ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh plants the seed of the True Name, and it sprouts. He deals in the True Name alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਤੁ ਲਾਹੈ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo it laahai laaian bhagatee dei bha(n)daar ||3||
lines.translation: Those whom the Lord has attached to this profitable venture, are granted the treasure of devotional worship. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sadaa sohaaganee bhai bhagat seegaar ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is forever the true, happy soul-bride; she adorns herself with the fear of God and devotion to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: anadin raavahi pir aapanaa sach rakhahi ur dhaar ||4||
lines.translation: Night and day, she enjoys her Husband Lord; she keeps Truth enshrined within her heart. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhaa pir raaviaa aapanaa tinhaa vitahu bal jaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who have enjoyed their Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa pir kai sa(n)g rahahi vichahu aap gavaai ||5||
lines.translation: They dwell forever with their Husband Lord; they eradicate self-conceit from within. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man seetal mukh ujale pir kai bhaai piaar ||
lines.translation: Their bodies and minds are cooled and soothed, and their faces are radiant, from the love and affection of their Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: sej sukhaalee pir ravai haumai trisanaa maar ||6||
lines.translation: They enjoy their Husband Lord upon His cozy bed, having conquered their ego and desire. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa ghar aaiaa gur kai het apaar ||
lines.translation: Granting His Grace, He comes into our homes, through our infinite Love for the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕੇਵਲ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: var paaiaa sohaaganee keval ek muraar ||7||
lines.translation: The happy soul-bride obtains the One Lord as her Husband. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਗੁਨਹ ਬਖਸਾਇ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe gunah bakhasaai laion mele melanahaar ||
lines.translation: All of her sins are forgiven; the Uniter unites her with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੮॥੧੨॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhan aakheeai je sun dhare piaar ||8||12||34||
lines.translation: O Nanak, chant such chants, that hearing them, He may enshrine love for you. ||8||12||34||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਊਪਜੈ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur te gun oopajai jaa prabh melai soi ||
lines.translation: Merit is obtained from the True Guru, when God causes us to meet Him.
